entries.62a9ea1bf213482f: This is an industry whose work is the "functions of money": taking in, lending, protecting, growing and moving money. Banks take in deposits and make loans, and insurance companies underwrite protection against the unexpected. Securities companies broker the trading of stocks and investment trusts, and leasing and lending companies lend funds and equipment. Payment companies connect payment information between stores and card companies. There are also cases where manufacturers and retailers run financial businesses for the customers who buy their own products.
